test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn graphs for structural equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn graphs for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering but checking structure
test_gtn_loadtxt_savetxt: test loading and saving gtn graphs to text format using gtn.loadtxt and gtn.savetxt
test_gtn_load_save: test loading and saving gtn graphs to binary format using gtn.load and gtn.save
test_gtn_graph_construction: test building gtn graphs with add_node and add_arc including start accept and epsilon labels
